name: faye-coding-assistant
description: Focused, scope-preserving repository skills for exploration, change planning, implementation, debugging, review, refactor and verification planning, test-suite health, handoff, documentation, coding goals, and source-file token estimation.

interface.longDescription: Faye Coding Assistant provides independent, scope-preserving skills for codebase exploration, repository change planning, authorized implementation, debugging, general and phased review, refactor and verification planning, test-suite health, and coding handoff. Shared read-only and write-authorized agents remain permission-bounded helpers, while separate skills cover coding-goal guardrails, progress reporting, documentation reconciliation, and explicit source-file token estimation.
defaultPrompt: Use $codebase-exploration to map ownership and execution flow for this repository question.
Use $repository-change-planning to create a repository-backed implementation plan for this change.
Use $repository-implementation to make this bounded repository change with proportionate verification.
